Clauditor

Claude Code usage & cost dashboard

Previously used:
Browser needs folder permission again.

How to get started

Claude keeps its usage logs in two separate places on your machine. Browse each source you want to include, then open the dashboard. You can start with just one — regular Chats have no local usage data and can never be counted.

Code Claude Code sessions

Every Claude Code session — the terminal CLI and the Desktop app's Code tab. This is the main data source.

macOS/Linux ~/.claude/projects
Windows %USERPROFILE%\.claude\projects
Cowork Cowork tasks (optional)

Tasks run from the Desktop app's Home tab. They are stored separately from Claude Code logs, in the app's own data folder — press ⌘⇧G in the dialog and paste the path below. The browser cannot remember this folder (it lives under ~/Library), so re-browse it to pull in new tasks; with an archive set, loaded history is kept automatically.

macOS ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/local-agent-mode-sessions
Windows %APPDATA%\Claude\local-agent-mode-sessions
